headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of shutout pitching. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs. In other action, the New York Yankees defeated the Cleveland Guardians 8-4, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. The San Francisco Giants rallied to defeat the Washington Nationals 11-10, with a late surge securing their victory.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list. Oneil Cruz, the Pittsburgh Pirates' center fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The Los Angeles Angels have also placed Sebastián Rivero on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate fracture and Jack Kochanowicz on the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Kansas City Royals, Seattle Mariners, Chicago White Sox, Atlanta Braves, and more.

There have been several trades and roster moves around the league. Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers, while the Pittsburgh Pirates traded Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash, and the Arizona Diamondbacks traded Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash. Additionally, the Texas Rangers traded Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of shutout pitching. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Angel Martínez led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Giants Come From Behind to Win 11-10**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants rallied to defeat the Washington Nationals 11-10, with a late surge securing their victory. Bryce Eldridge's grand slam in the 8th inning proved to be the turning point in the game.

top_news.title: **Padres Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Fernando Tatis Jr. leading the charge at the plate. Tatis Jr. hit two home runs, including a key line drive to left field, and drove in two runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Cruz Sidelined with Hand Fractures**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The injury occurred on June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Waguespack Joins Tigers**
top_news.summary: Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers. The right-handed pitcher was previously acquired by the Tigers in a trade with the Milwaukee Brewers.
